name: tabs
title: Tabs with panels
summary: Three tabs (Songs, Albums, Artists): tapping one shows its panel through visibility modifiers and slides the underline under it.
prompt: Make a tab bar with three tabs (Songs, Albums, Artists); tapping a tab shows its panel and slides an underline under it.
teaches: Show one panel at a time with a visibility modifier bound to an integer variable (1 visible, 0 gone)
Run several actions from one onClick: set the selected tab and every panel's visibility
Slide an underline to the selected tab with one animated variable {"value": "@tab * 120 + 16", "anim": 0.25} that both edges read

snippets.note: show0: an int variable (vtype int), 1 for the first panel and 0 for the others
onClick with four actions: tab = 2, show0 = 0, show1 = 0, show2 = 1
ux: the underline left edge, animated over 0.25 s to the selected tab, a third of the live componentWidth() per tab; the bar is drawn from @ux to @ux + componentWidth() / 3 - 32

check.describe: Starts on Songs (blue panel); a tap on Artists shows the teal Artists panel and moves the underline to the third tab. Resized, the three weighted tabs share the width and the underline is a third of the live width minus 16 px each side: tapping the third tab moves it under Artists at 234 and at 540 wide, the track spanning the full width.

expect.layout_changes: the Artists panel becomes visible and Songs goes

pitfalls: visibility reads an integer variable, not a float: declare it with "vtype": "int" and change it with valueIntegerChange (1 visible, 0 gone)
There is no expression for visibility, so every tab's onClick must set all the panel integers, not just its own
Stack the panels in one box: gone panels take no space, so the visible one fills it
Accessibility inspectors may still list the hidden panels (the inspector does not yet drop GONE components)
An underline placed at @tab * 120 with a track drawn to x = 360 only lines up with the tabs at the header width; derive both from componentWidth() (the weighted tabs are a third of it each)
